integrity: Analytical all-size proof with a standalone finite checker. Self-review only; no independent audit or validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to the normalized exponential Matérn-half kernel on the real line and the matrix spectral condition number. The size-uniform supremum presumes arbitrarily many sites and no fixed total extent. It is not a statement about higher-dimensional or other kernels, the interpolation error, or floating-point stability; historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Sharp equal-spacing extremality for exponential-kernel interpolation matrices
